title: Concept: File access built from input (haskell) — review required
description: In haskell, readFile (dir ++ f) builds a file path from input, so traversal sequences can step outside the intended directory. The remedy is confinement to a base directory (canonicalize plus prefix check) plus normalization and an allowlist.
applicability: haskell file access; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Arbitrary file read or write; HIGH severity.
